evals.prompt: 请把这篇文章改写成一篇中文博客并生成封面，然后发布到微信公众号草稿箱：https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
evals.expected_output: 会先用 Chrome DevTools MCP 抓取正文并形成结构化笔记，再生成中文 Markdown 博客。封面阶段默认读取 `references/cover-prompt-template.md`，创建 `src/assets/{ID}/cover-brief.json`，优先调用 `imagegen` 生成宽封面，把最终选中图保存为 `src/assets/{ID}/01-cover.{ext}`，并把 `ogImage` 与 `wechat-draft` 的 `cover-image` 都指向这个最终实际路径。

assertions.text: Cover generation uses `imagegen` as the default backend, not `azure-image-gen`.
The workflow creates or describes a cover brief before writing the final image prompt.
The final cover image is saved under `src/assets/{ID}/` rather than left in a generated-images temp/default directory.
`ogImage` and the WeChat `cover-image` parameter reference the final cover path.

evals.prompt: 把这个产品发布页写成中文博客，封面用默认方式生成，不要做成产品截图：https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-image-2/
evals.expected_output: 会把文章类型识别为产品更新 / 发布型，封面 brief 中选择 `release`，用产品发布感但非广告横幅的视觉隐喻。prompt 明确包含 no text、no title、no watermark、no UI screenshot、no dashboard、no fake diagram labels、no fake terminal output 等限制，避免生成假产品界面或带标题字样的海报。

assertions.text: The cover type is selected from the fixed taxonomy and is appropriate for a product/release article.
The image prompt forbids visible title text, watermarks, UI screenshots, dashboards, fake diagrams, and fake terminal output.
The cover concept expresses the article theme without pretending to be a real product screenshot.

evals.prompt: 请用 Azure OpenAI 生成封面，把这篇英文教程改写成中文博客并推到微信草稿箱：https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/dall-e
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确指定 Azure 的要求，在封面阶段走 `azure-image-gen` 回退路径；仍然先生成 `cover-brief.json`，按模板构造 prompt，并把 Azure 脚本最终输出的实际文件路径（可能是 `.png`、`.jpg` 或 `.webp`）同步到 Markdown `ogImage` 和 `wechat-draft` 的 `cover-image`。

assertions.text: Explicit Azure preference overrides the default `imagegen` backend.
The Azure final output path extension is treated as authoritative.
The final image path is propagated consistently to blog frontmatter and WeChat publishing.

evals.prompt: 把这篇架构文章写成中文博客。封面可以参考正文里的架构图，但不能照抄，也不能生成假的架构标签：https://example.com/agent-workflow-architecture
evals.expected_output: 会把文章类型识别为架构 / 系统设计，先判断正文图片是否允许复用且是否只用于主体关系参考。封面 prompt 可以表达模块连接和流程关系，但必须避免复制原图、避免真实架构图截图感，并明确禁止 fake diagram labels、UI screenshot、dashboard、terminal output。

assertions.text: Reference images are used only for composition or subject relationships, not pixel-level copying.
Architecture covers may show conceptual connections but must not create fake labeled system diagrams.
The prompt includes a clear avoid list for fake labels and screenshot-like artifacts.

evals.prompt: 只把这个链接写成博客，不要生成封面，也不要发微信：https://example.com/short-note
evals.expected_output: 会尊重用户明确的范围限制：仍然抓取 URL、生成中文 Markdown、写入 frontmatter 和参考链接，但跳过 `imagegen` / `azure-image-gen` 封面生成，不写 `ogImage`，也不调用 `wechat-draft`。

assertions.text: The explicit no-cover request prevents any image generation backend from being invoked.
The explicit no-WeChat request prevents `wechat-draft` from being invoked.
The blog article is still generated normally without `ogImage`.
